# Violet Evening

Violet Evening applies a violet evening colour scheme across Obsidian, producing a dark interface with soft contrasts and readable typography. Its recorded description states that the editor, the panes and the surrounding UI elements are harmonized for comfortable low-light writing.

![Violet Evening screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aitadev/Violet-Evening-for-Obsidian/HEAD/screenshot.png)

    name:   "Violet Evening"
